description: This file is a shell script that automates testing scenarios related to Git notes merging operations. It includes functions for verifying notes, fanout structures, and executing a series of test cases to validate Git notes merge strategies and conflict resolution behaviors.

methods.name: verify_notes
methods.description: Verifies that the notes for a particular reference and commit match expected values by comparing the output of 'git notes' with a known good file and checking log consistency.

methods.name: verify_fanout
methods.description: Checks that the notes tree for a given reference has a fanout of 1, ensuring each path follows a specific pattern.

methods.name: verify_no_fanout
methods.description: Ensures that the notes tree for a given reference has no fanout, meaning no paths match the fanout pattern.
